resources.string: Don\'t worry, Rehan. Nothing is permanent. Market will move down and will move up as well. Allah SWT is with you and Insha\'a\'Allah your portfolio will rise exponentially. Just keep working hard and trade with analysis not emotions. Also, keep making your trades better each time.
Paste the relay admin token once to receive signals. The app checks the system every 15 minutes; on some phones also allow autostart and remove battery limits.
